tagline: Upload a PDF and hear it read aloud
brief: Readr reads PDFs aloud with word-by-word highlighting. The mark must connect reading and listening, replace the current book-and-sound-waves clip art, and fit the app's warm paper and orange interface.
criteria: Success: reads as book and sound at a glance, works at 16 px and in one colour, belongs with the app's existing palette.

concepts.name: Cutout, Bold
concepts.idea: A solid open book with a soundwave punched through it.
rationale: One silhouette holds both halves of the product: reading and listening
Five thick bars stay open at small sizes; a three-bar cut covers 16 px
Colour comes straight from the app's accent, so logo and interface match

recommendation: Cutout, Bold is the final direction.
next_steps: Swap the logo and icons into the web app and extension
Match a Pantone from a physical swatch before any print
